title: Password Reset
content: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
resolution_steps: Direct employee to the self-service password reset portal
If locked out (5+ failed attempts), IT unlocks the account manually
No approval is required for password resets

title: VPN Access
content: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
resolution_steps: Full-time employees: VPN access is automatic — check if credentials have expired (90-day cycle)
If expired, employee must renew credentials via the VPN portal
Contractors: require manager approval via access request form before VPN can be provisioned

title: Laptop Replacement
content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.
resolution_steps: Check laptop age — eligible for replacement after 3 years
If hardware failure verified, early replacement possible
Request must be raised at least 2 weeks before intended replacement date
Note: Asset Management Policy specifies a 4-year refresh cycle; early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval

title: Software Installation Requests
content: Standard software (listed in the approved catalog) can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
resolution_steps: Check if the software is in the approved catalog
If in catalog: employee can self-install from the software center
If not in catalog: submit for IT Security review (3–5 business days)
conditional_approval: Non-catalog software requires IT Security review

title: Printer Troubleshooting
content: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.
resolution_steps: Step 1: Check the printer queue for stuck jobs and clear them
Step 2: Restart the print spooler service
Step 3: If issue persists, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag for technician dispatch
follow_up_questions: What is the printer's asset tag?
Have you tried restarting the print spooler?
Which floor is the printer located on?

title: Email Mailbox Quota
content: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
resolution_steps: Step 1: Advise employee to archive old emails to free up space
Step 2: If still insufficient, a quota increase can be requested
Quota increase requires manager approval and is capped at 50GB
conditional_approval: Quota increase beyond 25GB requires manager approval

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
content: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
resolution_steps: Direct employee to the front-desk kiosk to generate guest Wi-Fi credentials
Credentials are valid for 24 hours
No IT ticket is required

title: Expense Software Access
content: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists.
resolution_steps: If the employee does not have an account: redirect to Finance department for account provisioning
If the employee has an existing account but faces technical/login issues: IT can assist
Clarify whether this is an account provisioning or a technical login issue

title: Security Incident Reporting
content: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.
resolution_steps: IMMEDIATE ESCALATION: Report to security@veridian-corp.example
DO NOT forward suspicious emails to other employees
Preserve the original email for investigation
If employee has already forwarded the email, escalate with higher urgency

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing — IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.
resolution_steps: Confirm employee works remotely more than 3 days per week
Employee must obtain manager sign-off
Finance processes the equipment allowance
Once approved, IT handles the equipment shipping request

title: Asset Management Policy (Extract)
content: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
resolution_steps: Standard hardware refresh cycle is 4 years from date of issue
Early replacement requires Finance sign-off AND IT approval
This policy is issued by Finance & Assets, last updated Q2 2026
